verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's self-hosted proxy issues virtual keys that control model access and track spend (litellm-docs-8, litellm-docs-5). Those keys can be scoped to teams or created without a team_id for individuals (litellm-docs-7, litellm-docs-26, litellm-docs-6), and the vendor pitches putting the whole stack 'behind one key' (litellm-docs-15). One community user mentions vague issues creating tokens for other users (litellm-comm-3), which lowers confidence but is not a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that provider credentials stay hidden behind virtual keys, details of the key-generation API and workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of key minting.
